Kuvitus: olohuone talvi-iltana. Ikkunan: Illustration: a living room on a winter evening. At the top of the window hangs an old string of Christmas lights whose bulbs are all dark, because one bulb is broken and dangles loose from its socket. The floor lamp and the desk lamp plugged into the sockets of the same extension cord shine brightly.
Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa: parist: Circuit diagram, not to scale: a battery and two resistors R1 and R2 in series in the same loop. Purple current arrows run from the positive terminal of the battery through R1 and R2 and back to the negative terminal, and the label of every arrow is the same, I. The voltages U1 and U2, marked with blue brackets, are across the resistors, and the battery voltage is U.

Circuit diagram, not to scale: a battery and two resistors R1 and R2 in parallel. The current I leaving the positive terminal of the battery divides at a branching point into two branches carrying the currents I1 and I2, and the currents join again at the second branching point. The same voltage U as between the terminals of the battery is across both resistors.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kokonaisresistans: Graph to scale: the total resistance R in ohms as a function of the resistor R2, when the other resistor R1 is 100 ohms. The line of the series connection rises from 100 ohms to 300 ohms as R2 grows from zero to 200 ohms. The curve of the parallel connection rises from zero to about 67 ohms and always stays below the dashed line at 100 ohms; at R2 = 100 ohms it is 50 ohms.
Kaksi kytkentäkaaviota vierekkäin, ei mi: Two circuit diagrams side by side, not to scale. On the left a resistor R1 is connected to a battery, and in series with it a group of two parallel resistors R2 and R3. On the right the same circuit, in which the parallel resistors are replaced with a single resistor R23 in series with R1.
